headline: RBI Rs 2.5 Lakh Crore Liquidity Injection Sparks Policy Debate
summary: The Reserve Bank of India injected Rs 2.5 lakh crore into the banking system via repo auctions, raising questions over its monetary tightening stance.
why: Central bank liquidity operations dictate short-term interbank interest rates and commercial bank lending capacity in domestic financial markets.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Massive liquidity infusions ease funding constraints for commercial banks operating in the financial system.

why_moved: The large-scale injection of funds surprised market participants who expected consistent monetary tightening to combat inflation.
